column8: The original package target is represented by dedicated tidb-mysql and tidb-error package tests and exercised together by the package campaign.
Every top-level constant and SQL-mode test in the upstream file has a matching Rust test obligation.
Valid release and server-version forms plus every invalid upstream input are asserted.
The legacy placeholder conversion and ordinary-version preservation cases are asserted.
All 33 SQL-mode bit identities, strict-mode behavior, deletion, combination expansion, normalization, and partial invalid-mode result are asserted.
The exact TiDB version separator is asserted.
Every top-level SQL-error test in the upstream file has a matching Rust test obligation.
Known and unknown codes, default SQLSTATE, catalog text, custom format text, nil rendering, and final Error string shape are asserted.
Every top-level privilege test in the upstream file has a matching Rust test obligation.
Every source privilege bit from Usage through All has a non-empty SQL spelling.
Every global, global-only, and database privilege has its exact column spelling and inverse lookup.
Every table and column privilege has its exact SET spelling and inverse lookup.
Positive and negative privilege-membership behavior is asserted exactly.
All source privilege bits have column names and the expected table-length relationships hold.
Every top-level type-flag test in the upstream file has a matching Rust test obligation.
Every upstream field-flag predicate is asserted with its corresponding flag bit.
